title: Dynamic-TD3: A Novel Algorithm for UAV Path Planning with Dynamic Obstacle Trajectory Prediction
summary: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) finds extensive application in autonomous drone navigation within complex, high-risk environments. However, its practical deployment faces a safety-exploration dilemma: soft penalty mechanisms encourage risky trial-and-error, while most constraint-based methods suffer degraded performance under sensor noise and intent uncertainty. We propose Dynamic-TD3, a physically enhanced framework that enforces strict safety constraints while maintaining maneuverability by modeling navigation as a Constrained Markov Decision Process (CMDP). This framework integrates an Adaptive Trajectory Relational Evolution Mechanism (ATREM) to capture long-range intentions and employs a Physically Aware Gated Kalman Filter (PAG-KF) to mitigate non-stationary observation noise. The resulting state representation drives a dual-criterion policy that balances mission efficiency against hard safety constraints via Lagrangian relaxation. In experiments with aggressive dynamic threats, this approach demonstrates superior collision avoidance performance, reduced energy consumption, and smoother flight trajectories.

AI.tldr: Dynamic-TD3 提出一种物理增强的深度强化学习框架，通过约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）和新型噪声滤波与轨迹演化机制，在保证严格安全约束的同时提升无人机在复杂环境中的导航效率与轨迹平滑性。
AI.motivation: 现有深度强化学习方法在无人机导航中面临安全与探索的权衡困境：软惩罚机制易导致高风险行为，而基于约束的方法在传感器噪声和意图不确定性下性能显著下降。
AI.method: 将导航建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP），引入自适应轨迹关系演化机制（ATREM）捕捉远距离意图，并设计物理感知门控卡尔曼滤波（PAG-KF）抑制非平稳观测噪声；采用基于拉格朗日松弛的双准则策略平衡任务效率与硬性安全约束。
AI.result: 在动态威胁环境下，Dynamic-TD3 在碰撞避免性能、能耗降低和飞行轨迹平滑性方面均显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功解决了安全与探索的权衡难题，通过物理一致性建模与鲁棒感知，实现了高风险环境中安全且高效的自主导航。

title: Being-H0.7: A Latent World-Action Model from Egocentric Videos
summary: Visual-Language-Action models (VLAs) have advanced generalist robot control by mapping multimodal observations and language instructions directly to actions, but sparse action supervision often encourages shortcut mappings rather than representations of dynamics, contact, and task progress. Recent world-action models introduce future prediction through video rollouts, yet pixel-space prediction is a costly and indirect substrate for control, as it may model visual details irrelevant to action generation and introduces substantial training or inference overhead. We present Being-H0.7, a latent world-action model that brings future-aware reasoning into VLA-style policies without generating future frames. Being-H0.7 inserts learnable latent queries between perception and action as a compact reasoning interface, and trains them with a future-informed dual-branch design: a deployable prior branch infers latent states from the current context, while a training-only posterior branch replaces the queries with embeddings from future observations. Jointly aligning the two branches at the latent reasoning space leads the prior branch to reason future-aware, action-useful structure from current observations alone. At inference, Being-H0.7 discards the posterior branch and performs no visual rollout. Experiments across six simulation benchmarks and diverse real-world tasks show that Being-H0.7 achieves state-of-the-art or comparable performance, combining the predictive benefits of world models with the efficiency and deployability of direct VLA policies.

AI.tldr: Being-H0.7 introduces a latent world-action model that enables future-aware reasoning in VLA policies without generating future frames, achieving state-of-the-art performance with high efficiency by using learnable latent queries aligned via a dual-branch training scheme.
AI.motivation: Sparse action supervision in Visual-Language-Action (VLA) models leads to shortcut mappings that ignore dynamics and task progress; existing future-prediction approaches are inefficient due to costly pixel-space video rollouts that model irrelevant visual details.
AI.method: Being-H0.7 introduces learnable latent queries as a reasoning interface between perception and action, trained with a dual-branch design: a deployable prior branch infers latent states from current observations, and a training-only posterior branch uses future observation embeddings to supervise alignment—enabling future-aware reasoning without visual rollouts at inference.
AI.result: Being-H0.7 achieves state-of-the-art or comparable performance across six simulation benchmarks and diverse real-world tasks, matching the predictive power of world models while retaining the efficiency and deployability of direct VLA policies.
AI.conclusion: Latent reasoning interfaces with dual-branch supervision enable efficient, future-aware control in VLA models, eliminating the need for expensive pixel-space prediction and offering a scalable path toward generalist robotic reasoning.

title: World Model for Robot Learning: A Comprehensive Survey
summary: World models, which are predictive representations of how environments evolve under actions, have become a central component of robot learning. They support policy learning, planning, simulation, evaluation, data generation, and have advanced rapidly with the rise of foundation models and large-scale video generation. However, the literature remains fragmented across architectures, functional roles, and embodied application domains. To address this gap, we present a comprehensive review of world models from a robot-learning perspective. We examine how world models are coupled with robot policies, how they serve as learned simulators for reinforcement learning and evaluation, and how robotic video world models have progressed from imagination-based generation to controllable, structured, and foundation-scale formulations. We further connect these ideas to navigation and autonomous driving, and summarize representative datasets, benchmarks, and evaluation protocols. Overall, this survey systematically reviews the rapidly growing literature on world models for robot learning, clarifies key paradigms and applications, and highlights major challenges and future directions for predictive modeling in embodied agents. To facilitate continued access to newly emerging works, benchmarks, and resources, we will maintain and regularly update the accompanying GitHub repository alongside this survey.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了机器人学习中世界模型的研究进展，涵盖其与策略的耦合、作为学习模拟器的角色、视频世界模型的演进，以及在导航和自动驾驶中的应用，并总结了数据集、基准和评估协议，同时承诺持续更新GitHub资源库。
AI.motivation: 当前世界模型的研究在架构、功能角色和应用场景上高度碎片化，缺乏统一的视角来理解其在机器人学习中的整体发展脉络，亟需一篇系统性综述来整合和厘清关键范式与挑战。
AI.method: 通过文献综述方法，从机器人学习角度系统分析世界模型的结构、功能（如策略耦合、模拟器作用）、技术演进（从想象生成到可控、结构化、基础模型驱动），并关联导航与自动驾驶等具体任务，归纳代表性数据集与评估协议。
AI.result: 厘清了世界模型在机器人学习中的三大核心角色（策略支持、学习模拟器、视频生成），揭示了其从无结构生成向可控、结构化、基础模型驱动的演进路径，并建立了与实际机器人任务（如导航）的明确联系，整理出标准化评估资源。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型已成为机器人学习的核心支柱，未来发展方向包括提升模型的可解释性、结构化表征能力、跨任务泛化性，以及构建更统一的评估体系；作者将持续维护GitHub资源库以支持社区发展。

title: Two-View Accumulation as the Primary Training Lever for Hybrid-Capture Gaussian Splatting: A Variance-Decomposition View of When Gradient Surgery Helps
summary:
Hybrid-capture novel view synthesis combines images at substantially different camera distances (e.g., aerial drone and ground-level views). Standard 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), trained for 30K iterations with one rendered view per optimizer step, under-fits the minority regime by 1-3 dB on five hybrid-capture benchmarks. We isolate the lever that closes this gap.
  Among compute-matched alternatives -- vanilla 60K iterations, magnitude corrections (GradNorm), direction-aware near/far gradient surgery, projective preconditioning, confidence-gated sample-level surgery, and a random two-view-per-step control -- the simplest structural change wins: rendering two views per optimizer step. The pairing rule (geometry-defined near/far, random, or active loss-disparity) does not change PSNR beyond seed variance on any of the five scenes; the structural change of having two views per step does.
  We propose a variance-decomposition framework that predicts and explains this finding: under bimodal camera regimes, between-regime gradient variance turns out to be small relative to within-regime variance in 3DGS, so structured and random pairings are variance-equivalent in expectation, and the variance halving from two-view accumulation itself is the dominant effect. We verify the framework on five scenes whose camera-altitude bimodality coefficients span [0.55, 1.00], and we report the negative result that direction-aware projection, magnitude correction, confidence gating, and an active loss-disparity pairing all fall within seed variance of random two-view pairing. The two-view structural lever transfers cleanly to the Scaffold-GS and Pixel-GS backbones.
  We position this work as an honest characterization of which training-side axes do and do not move PSNR for hybrid-capture 3DGS, together with the framework that explains why.

AI.tldr: Rendering two views per optimizer step significantly improves 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) performance in hybrid-capture scenarios (e.g., aerial + ground views), outperforming complex methods like gradient surgery or preconditioning; the gain stems from variance reduction, not structured pairing, and generalizes across backbones.
AI.motivation: Standard 3DGS under-fits hybrid-capture datasets with extreme camera distance differences (e.g., drone vs. ground), suffering 1–3 dB PSNR loss; prior attempts to fix this with complex training modifications failed to consistently outperform simple baselines, motivating a systematic analysis of what truly drives performance gains.
AI.method: Systematically evaluate 6 compute-matched training modifications on five hybrid-capture benchmarks: (1) vanilla 60K iterations, (2) GradNorm, (3) direction-aware gradient surgery, (4) projective preconditioning, (5) confidence-gated sampling, (6) random two-view-per-step. Introduce a variance-decomposition framework to model gradient behavior under bimodal camera regimes and validate it empirically.
AI.result: Only rendering two views per step (regardless of pairing strategy: geometry-based, random, or active) improves PSNR by 1–3 dB over single-view training; all other methods fall within seed variance. Variance decomposition shows between-regime gradient variance is small, making pairings variance-equivalent—halving within-regime variance via two-view accumulation is the dominant effect. The gain transfers to Scaffold-GS and Pixel-GS.
AI.conclusion: The key lever for improving hybrid-capture 3DGS is not complex gradient manipulation but the simple structural change of doubling views per optimization step. The proposed variance framework explains why: bimodal camera setups have low cross-regime gradient variance, rendering structured pairing unnecessary. This work clarifies which training-axis interventions matter—and which don’t—for hybrid-view synthesis.

title: E$^2$DT: Efficient and Effective Decision Transformer with Experience-Aware Sampling for Robotic Manipulation
summary: In reinforcement learning (RL) for robotic manipulation, the Decision Transformer (DT) has emerged as an effective framework for addressing long-horizon tasks. However, DT's performance depends heavily on the coverage of collected experiences. Without an active exploration mechanism, standard DT relies on uniform replay, which leads to poor sample efficiency, limited exploration, and reduced overall effectiveness. At the same time, while excessive exploration can help avoid local optima, it often delays policy convergence and leads to degraded efficiency. To address these limitations, we propose E$^2$DT, a DT-guided k-Determinantal Point Process sampling framework that enables the model to actively shape its own experience selection. Our framework is experience-aware, allowing E$^2$DT to be both efficient, by prioritizing sampling quality, such as high-return, high-uncertainty, and underrepresented trajectories, and effective, by ensuring diversity across trajectory windows to preserve policy optimality. Specifically, DT's internal latent embeddings measure diversity across trajectory windows, while quality is quantified through a composite metric that integrates return-to-go (RTG) quantiles, predictive uncertainty, and stage coverage based on inverse frequency. These two dimensions are integrated into a novel quality-diversity joint kernel that prioritizes the most informative experiences, thereby enabling learning that is both efficient and effective. We evaluate E$^2$DT on challenging robotic manipulation benchmarks in both simulation and real-robot settings. Results show that it consistently outperforms prior methods. These findings demonstrate that coupling policy learning with experience-aware sampling provides a principled path toward robust long-horizon robotic learning.

AI.tldr: E²DT 提出一种基于决策变换器（DT）的主动经验采样框架，通过 k-Determinantal Point Process 联合优化经验的质量与多样性，显著提升机器人长时程任务的样本效率与策略性能。
AI.motivation: 标准决策变换器依赖均匀重放，导致样本效率低、探索不足且易陷入局部最优；而过度探索又会延迟收敛。亟需一种既能优先高质量经验、又能保持轨迹多样性的主动采样机制。
AI.method: 提出 E²DT 框架，利用 DT 的隐层嵌入衡量轨迹窗口间的多样性，并构建复合质量指标（含 return-to-go 分位数、预测不确定性、阶段覆盖频率倒数），结合新型质量-多样性联合核函数，通过 k-DPP 实现最优经验采样。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实机器人多任务基准上，E²DT 显著优于现有方法，展现出更高的样本效率、更强的探索能力与更优的策略收敛性。
AI.conclusion: 将策略学习与经验感知采样相结合，是实现高效、鲁棒长时程机器人学习的有原则路径，E²DT 为决策变换器提供了可扩展的主动学习范式。

authors: Udayanga G. W. K. N. Gamage
title: Real-Time Frame- and Event-based Object Detection with Spiking Neural Networks on Edge Neuromorphic Hardware: Design, Deployment and Benchmark
summary: Real-time object detection on energy-constrained platforms is critical for applications such as UAV-based inspection, autonomous navigation, and mobile robotics. Spiking neural networks (SNNs) on neuromorphic hardware are believed to be significantly more energy-efficient than conventional artificial neural networks (ANNs). In this work, we present a comprehensive methodology for designing general SNN detection architectures targeting neuromorphic platforms, along with the engineering adaptations required to deploy them on the state-of-the-art Neuromorphic processor, Intel Loihi 2. We benchmark SNN-based object detection on Loihi 2 using both frame-based and event-based datasets, comparing performance with ANN-based detection on the NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano, NVIDIA Jetson Nano B01, and the Apple M2 CPU. Our results show that SNNs on Loihi 2 can perform real-time detection while achieving the lowest per-inference dynamic energy among all platforms. Also, Loihi 2 outperforms the other platforms in terms of power consumption, though ANNs on Jetson Orin Nano achieve higher inference rates. Furthermore, our ANN-to-SNN distillation-aware training enables SNNs to recover 87-100% of the detection accuracy of their ANN counterparts while maintaining lower inference latency; without distillation, SNNs exhibit an 11-27% accuracy drop. These results highlight the potential of neuromorphic systems for energy-efficient, real-time object detection at the edge.

AI.tldr: SNNs on Intel Loihi 2 achieve energy-efficient real-time object detection, outperforming ANNs on Jetson and M2 in power efficiency while maintaining high accuracy via distillation-aware training.
AI.motivation: Real-time object detection on energy-constrained edge devices (e.g., UAVs, robots) demands ultra-low power solutions; SNNs on neuromorphic hardware offer a promising alternative to conventional ANNs by leveraging event-driven computation for superior energy efficiency.
AI.method: The authors design general SNN detection architectures tailored for neuromorphic platforms, implement engineering adaptations for Intel Loihi 2, and employ ANN-to-SNN distillation-aware training to preserve accuracy. They benchmark performance using both frame-based and event-based datasets, comparing SNNs on Loihi 2 against ANNs on NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano, Jetson Nano B01, and Apple M2 CPU.
AI.result: SNNs on Loihi 2 achieve the lowest per-inference dynamic energy and superior power efficiency, though ANNs on Jetson Orin Nano yield higher inference rates. Distillation-aware training enables SNNs to recover 87–100% of ANN accuracy; without it, accuracy drops by 11–27%. SNNs also maintain lower inference latency.
AI.conclusion: Neuromorphic systems like Loihi 2 are highly promising for energy-efficient, real-time edge object detection, with distillation-aware training being critical to closing the accuracy gap with ANNs while preserving energy advantages.

title: Embodied Interpretability: Linking Causal Understanding to Generalization in Vision-Language-Action Models
comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies often fail under distribution shift, suggesting that decisions may depend on spurious visual correlations rather than task-relevant causes. We formulate visual-action attribution as an interventional estimation problem. Accordingly, we introduce the Interventional Significance Score (ISS), an interventional masking procedure for estimating the causal influence of visual regions on action predictions, and the Nuisance Mass Ratio (NMR), a scalar measure of attribution to task-irrelevant features. We analyze the statistical properties of ISS and show that it admits unbiased estimation, and we characterize conditions under which action prediction error provides a valid proxy for causal influence. Experiments across diverse manipulation tasks indicate that NMR predicts generalization behavior and that ISS yields more faithful explanations than existing interpretability methods. These results suggest that interventional attribution provides a simple diagnostic approach for identifying causal misalignment in embodied policies.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出干预显著性分数（ISS）和干扰质量比（NMR），用于诊断视觉-语言-动作策略在分布偏移下的因果错配问题，表明干预性归因能更准确识别任务无关的视觉伪相关，提升模型可解释性与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在分布偏移下表现不佳，可能因依赖视觉伪相关而非任务因果特征，亟需一种能量化视觉区域对动作预测因果影响的可解释方法。
AI.method: 将视觉-动作归因建模为干预估计问题，提出干预显著性分数（ISS）——一种通过干预遮罩估计视觉区域因果影响的方法，并定义干扰质量比（NMR）——衡量模型对任务无关特征的归因比例；理论证明ISS的无偏性，并建立动作预测误差与因果影响的关联条件。
AI.result: 在多样化的操作任务中，NMR能有效预测模型泛化性能，ISS相比现有可解释性方法提供更忠实的归因解释，验证了干预性归因在诊断因果错配中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 干预性归因框架为评估和改进具身智能体的因果对齐提供了简单而有效的诊断工具，有助于构建更鲁棒、可解释的VLA策略。

title: VkSplat: High-Performance 3DGS Training in Vulkan Compute
summary: We present VkSplat, a high-performance, cross-vendor 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) training pipeline implemented fully in Vulkan compute, addressing performance and compatibility limitation of existing training pipelines. With various optimizations, we achieve $3.3\times$ speed and $33\%$ VRAM reduction over CUDA+PyTorch baseline, maintaining quality, and demonstrating compatibility across GPU vendors. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first fully-Vulkan-based 3DGS training pipeline that achieves state-of-the-art performance. Code: \href{https://github.com/harry7557558/vksplat}{https://github.com/harry7557558/vksplat}

AI.tldr: VkSplat 是首个完全基于 Vulkan compute 的 3D 高斯泼溅（3DGS）训练管道，相比 CUDA+PyTorch 基线实现 3.3 倍加速和 33% 显存降低，且跨厂商兼容。
AI.motivation: 现有 3DGS 训练管道依赖 CUDA 和 PyTorch，存在厂商锁定、性能瓶颈和跨平台兼容性差的问题，亟需一种高效、开放、跨硬件的解决方案。
AI.method: 设计并实现了一个完全基于 Vulkan compute 的 3DGS 训练管道，通过底层计算优化、内存布局改进和跨平台调度策略，消除对 CUDA 和 PyTorch 的依赖。
AI.result: 在保持渲染质量不变的前提下，相比 CUDA+PyTorch 基线，VkSplat 实现了 3.3 倍训练速度提升和 33% 显存占用降低，并在多种 GPU 厂商设备上验证了兼容性。
AI.conclusion: VkSplat 是首个高性能、跨厂商的全 Vulkan 3DGS 训练系统，为 3DGS 的开放生态和工业部署提供了新范式，具有重要实用价值。

title: PrefMoE: Robust Preference Modeling with Mixture-of-Experts Reward Learning
summary: Preference-based reinforcement learning offers a scalable alternative to manual reward engineering by learning reward structures from comparative feedback. However, large-scale preference datasets, whether collected from crowdsourced annotators or generated by synthetic teachers, often contain heterogeneous and partially conflicting supervision, including disagreement across annotators and inconsistency within annotators. Existing reward learning methods typically fit a single reward model to such data, forcing it to average incompatible signals and thereby limiting robustness. To solve this, we propose PrefMoE, a mixture-of-experts reward learning framework for robust preference modeling. PrefMoE learns multiple specialized reward experts and uses trajectory-level soft routing to combine them adaptively, enabling the model to capture diverse latent preference patterns under noisy and heterogeneous preference supervision. A load-balancing regularizer further stabilizes training by preventing expert collapse. Across locomotion benchmarks from D4RL and manipulation tasks from MetaWorld, PrefMoE improves preference prediction robustness and leads to more reliable downstream policy learning than strong single-model baselines.

AI.tldr: PrefMoE 提出一种混合专家奖励学习框架，通过轨迹级软路由整合多个专业奖励模型，有效应对偏好数据中的异质性和冲突，提升奖励预测鲁棒性与策略学习可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有奖励学习方法将异质且冲突的偏好数据拟合为单一奖励模型，导致信号平均化，降低模型鲁棒性；亟需一种能捕捉多样潜在偏好模式的机制。
AI.method: PrefMoE 构建混合专家架构，学习多个专业化奖励专家，并引入轨迹级软路由机制自适应组合专家输出，辅以负载均衡正则化项防止专家坍缩。
AI.result: 在 D4RL 运动基准和 MetaWorld 操作任务中，PrefMoE 显著优于单模型基线，在偏好预测准确率和下游策略学习稳定性上均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 混合专家框架能有效处理噪声与异构偏好数据，通过专家分工与自适应融合实现更鲁棒的奖励建模，为可扩展偏好强化学习提供新范式。

title: Learning while Deploying: Fleet-Scale Reinforcement Learning for Generalist Robot Policies
summary: Generalist robot policies increasingly benefit from large-scale pretraining, but offline data alone is insufficient for robust real-world deployment. Deployed robots encounter distribution shifts, long-tail failures, task variations, and human correction opportunities that fixed demonstration datasets cannot fully capture. We present Learning While Deploying (LWD), a fleet-scale offline-to-online reinforcement learning framework for continual post-training of generalist Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies. Starting from a pretrained VLA policy, LWD closes the loop between deployment, shared physical experience, policy improvement, and redeployment by using autonomous rollouts and human interventions collected across a robot fleet. To stabilize learning from heterogeneous, sparse-reward fleet data, LWD combines Distributional Implicit Value Learning (DIVL) for robust value estimation with Q-learning via Adjoint Matching (QAM) for policy extraction in flow-based VLA action generators. We validate LWD on a fleet of 16 dual-arm robots across eight real-world manipulation tasks, including semantic grocery restocking and 3--5 minute long-horizon tasks. A single generalist policy improves as fleet experience accumulates, reaching an average success rate of 95%, with the largest gains on long-horizon tasks.

AI.tldr: LWD 是一种大规模离线到在线强化学习框架，通过机器人舰队的自主 rollout 和人类干预实现通用 VLA 策略的持续优化，最终在 16 台机器人上实现平均 95% 的成功率，尤其在长周期任务中提升显著。
AI.motivation: 现有离线预训练的通用机器人策略在真实部署中面临分布偏移、长尾失败、任务变化和人类修正机会等挑战，固定演示数据无法充分覆盖，亟需一种能持续从部署经验中学习的在线学习框架。
AI.method: LWD 构建了一个舰队规模的离线到在线强化学习闭环，结合自主 rollout 与人类干预数据，采用 Distributional Implicit Value Learning (DIVL) 稳定异构稀疏奖励下的价值估计，并通过 Q-learning via Adjoint Matching (QAM) 从基于流的 VLA 动作生成器中提取策略。
AI.result: 在 16 台双臂机器人上对 8 项真实操作任务（如语义杂货补货和 3–5 分钟长周期任务）进行验证，单一通用策略随舰队经验积累持续提升，平均成功率达 95%，长周期任务提升最显著。
AI.conclusion: LWD 证明了通过舰队规模的实时部署与经验共享，可有效克服离线数据局限，实现通用机器人策略的持续进化，为真实世界部署提供了可扩展、高鲁棒性的学习范式。

title: Stereo Multistage Spatial Attention for Real-Time Mobile Manipulation Under Visual Scale Variation and Disturbances
summary: Robots operating in open, unstructured real-world environments must rely on onboard visual perception while autonomously moving across different locations. Continuous changes in onboard camera viewpoints cause significant visual scale variations in target objects, affecting vision-based motion generation. In this work, we present a stereo multistage spatial attention-based deep predictive learning method for real-time mobile manipulation. The proposed methods extracts task-relevant spatial attention points from stereo images and integrates them with robot states through a hierarchical recurrent architecture for closed-loop action prediction. We evaluate the system on four real-world mobile manipulation tasks using a mobile manipulator, including rigid placement, articulated object manipulation, and deformable object interaction. Experiments under randomized initial positions and visual disturbance conditions demonstrate improved robustness and task success rates compared to representative imitation learning and vision-language-action baselines under identical control settings. The results indicate that structured stereo spatial attention combined with predictive temporal modeling provides an effective solution within the evaluated mobile manipulation scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于立体多阶段空间注意力的深度预测学习方法，提升机器人在动态视觉变化下的实时移动操作鲁棒性与成功率。
AI.motivation: 机器人在开放非结构化环境中自主移动时，因摄像头视角连续变化导致目标物体视觉尺度剧烈波动，严重影响基于视觉的运动生成，现有模仿学习与视觉-语言-动作基线方法在此类场景中鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 采用立体图像提取任务相关空间注意力点，通过分层循环架构融合机器人状态，实现闭环动作预测，结合结构化立体空间注意力与预测性时序建模。
AI.result: 在四种真实移动操作任务（刚性放置、关节物体操作、可变形物体交互）中，相较于基线方法，在随机初始位姿与视觉干扰条件下显著提升任务成功率与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 结构化立体空间注意力机制配合预测性时序建模，为移动操作场景提供了高效、鲁棒的视觉-动作预测解决方案。

title: MSACT: Multistage Spatial Alignment for Stable Low-Latency Fine Manipulation
summary: Real-world fine manipulation, particularly in bimanual manipulation, typically requires low-latency control and stable visual localization, while collecting large-scale data is costly and limited demonstrations may lead to localization drift. Existing approaches make different trade-offs: action-chunking policies such as ACT enable low-latency execution and data efficiency but rely on dense visual features without explicit spatial consistency, generative methods such as Diffusion Policy improve expressiveness but can incur iterative sampling latency, vision-language-action and voxel-based methods enhance generalization and geometric grounding but require higher computational cost and system complexity. We introduce a multistage spatial attention module that extracts stable 2D attention points and jointly predicts future attention sequences with a temporal alignment loss. Built upon ACT with a pretrained ResNet visual prior, a multistage attention module extracts task-relevant 2D attention points as a local spatial modality for action prediction. To maintain consistent object tracking, we introduce a self-supervised objective that aligns predicted attention sequences with visual features from future frames, suppressing drift without keypoint annotations and improving stability of the vision-to-action mapping under limited data. Experiments on simulated and real-world fine manipulation tasks, conducted on the ALOHA bimanual platform, evaluate task success, attention drift, inference latency, and robustness to visual disturbances. Results indicate improvements in localization stability and task performance while maintaining low-latency inference under the tested conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文在ACT框架基础上引入多阶段空间注意力模块，通过自监督对齐未来帧视觉特征，实现低延迟、高稳定性的双手机器人精细操作，有效缓解视觉定位漂移问题。
AI.motivation: 现实中的双手机器人精细操作需低延迟控制与稳定视觉定位，但大规模数据采集成本高、示范样本有限易导致定位漂移，现有方法在延迟、表达能力、计算开销与几何一致性之间存在权衡。
AI.method: 基于ACT与预训练ResNet视觉先验，提出多阶段空间注意力模块，提取任务相关的2D注意力点作为局部空间模态；引入自监督时序对齐损失，对齐预测注意力序列与未来帧视觉特征，无需关键点标注即可抑制漂移。
AI.result: 在ALOHA双手机器人平台上实验表明，该方法在模拟与真实任务中显著提升定位稳定性与任务成功率，同时保持低延迟推理，并对视觉干扰具有更强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 多阶段空间注意力机制结合自监督时序对齐，有效平衡了低延迟控制与视觉定位稳定性，在有限数据下实现了高性能的精细操作，为机器人视觉-动作映射提供了新范式。

title: Thinking in Text and Images: Interleaved Vision--Language Reasoning Traces for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
summary: Long-horizon robotic manipulation requires plans that are both logically coherent and geometrically grounded. Existing Vision-Language-Action policies usually hide planning in latent states or expose only one modality: text-only chain-of-thought encodes causal order but misses spatial constraints, while visual prediction provides geometric cues but often remains local and semantically underconstrained. We introduce Interleaved Vision--Language Reasoning (IVLR), a policy framework built around \trace{}, an explicit intermediate representation that alternates textual subgoals with visual keyframes over the full task horizon. At test time, a single native multimodal transformer self-generates this global semantic-geometric trace from the initial observation and instruction, caches it, and conditions a closed-loop action decoder on the trace, original instruction, and current observation. Because standard robot datasets lack such traces, we construct pseudo-supervision by temporally segmenting demonstrations and captioning each stage with a vision-language model. Across simulated benchmarks for long-horizon manipulation and visual distribution shift, \method{} reaches 95.5\% average success on LIBERO, including 92.4\% on LIBERO-Long, and 59.4\% overall success on SimplerEnv-WidowX. Ablations show that both modalities are necessary: without traces, LIBERO-Long success drops to 37.7\%; text-only and vision-only traces reach 62.0\% and 68.4\%, while the full interleaved trace reaches 92.4\%. Stress tests with execution perturbations and masked trace content show moderate degradation, suggesting that the trace can tolerate local corruption and moderate execution drift, but remains limited under stale or incorrect global plans.

AI.tldr: IVLR 提出一种交错视觉-语言推理框架，通过显式中间表示（trace）联合建模任务的语义子目标与视觉关键帧，在长周期机器人操作任务中实现高成功率（LIBERO 达 95.5%），显著优于单模态方法。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作策略要么将规划隐藏在潜在状态中，要么仅使用文本（缺失几何约束）或视觉（局部且语义不足）模态，难以同时满足长周期任务的逻辑连贯性与几何精确性。
AI.method: 引入 Interleaved Vision-Language Reasoning (IVLR)，构建由文本子目标与视觉关键帧交替组成的全局语义-几何 trace，由单个多模态变换器自动生成并缓存，用于条件化闭环动作解码器；通过分割演示数据并使用视觉语言模型生成伪监督信号构建训练数据。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO 上平均成功率达 95.5%（LIBERO-Long 为 92.4%），在 SimplerEnv-WidowX 上达 59.4%；消融实验表明完整交错 trace 性能显著优于单模态（文本/视觉）trace（62.0%/68.4%），无 trace 时性能骤降至 37.7%；对执行扰动和部分 trace 掩码具有鲁棒性，但对全局错误计划敏感。
AI.conclusion: 显式交错的视觉-语言 trace 是实现长周期机器人操作中逻辑与几何协同规划的关键，该方法在不依赖人工标注 trace 的前提下，通过伪监督有效提升了任务完成率与泛化能力。

title: GOR-IS: 3D Gaussian Object Removal in the Intrinsic Space
summary: Recent advances in Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have made it standard practice to reconstruct 3D scenes from multi-view images. Removing objects from such 3D representations is a fundamental editing task that requires complete and seamless inpainting of occluded regions, ensuring consistency in geometry and appearance. Although existing methods have made notable progress in improving inpainting consistency, they often neglect global lighting effects, leading to physically implausible results. Moreover, these methods struggle with view-dependent non-Lambertian surfaces, where appearance varies across viewpoints, leading to unreliable inpainting. In this paper, we present 3D Gaussian Object Removal in the Intrinsic Space (GOR-IS), a novel framework for physically consistent and visually coherent 3D object removal. Our approach decomposes the scene into intrinsic components and explicitly models light transport to maintain global lighting effects consistency. Furthermore, we introduce an intrinsic-space inpainting module that operates directly in the material and lighting domains, effectively addressing the challenges posed by non-Lambertian surfaces. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that our framework substantially improves the physical consistency and visual coherence of object removal, outperforming existing methods by 13% in perceptual similarity (LPIPS) and 2dB in peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR). Code is publicly available at https://applezyh.github.io/GOR-IS-project-page/

AI.tldr: GOR-IS 提出一种在内在空间中进行 3D 高斯点云物体移除的新框架，通过建模光传输和分解材质与光照成分，实现物理一致且视觉连贯的遮挡区域补全，显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在 3D 场景物体移除中忽视全局光照一致性，且对视点依赖的非朗伯表面（如镜面、光泽材质）处理不佳，导致补全结果物理不合理、视觉不连贯。
AI.method: GOR-IS 将场景分解为内在材质与光照分量，在内在空间中直接进行补全，并显式建模光传输过程，以保持全局光照一致性；提出内在空间补全模块，有效应对非朗伯表面的视点依赖性。
AI.result: 在合成与真实数据集上，GOR-IS 在感知相似性（LPIPS）上提升 13%，在峰值信噪比（PSNR）上提升 2dB，显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过在内在空间建模材质与光照并显式控制光传输，GOR-IS 实现了物理真实、视觉连贯的 3D 物体移除，为高保真场景编辑提供了新范式。

title: 2D-SuGaR: Surface-Aware Gaussian Splatting for Geometrically Accurate Mesh Reconstruction
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as a powerful technique for generating photorealistic renderings of a scene in real-time. However, the volumetric nature of 3DGS limits its ability to accurately capture surface geometry. To address this, 2D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS) was proposed to enable view-consistent and geometrically accurate surface reconstruction from multi-view images. However, 2DGS can be sensitive to the initialization of the Gaussian primitives. Reliance on Structure-from-Motion (SfM) initializations, which can produce poor estimates on challenging image sets, may lead to subpar results. In this work, we enhance 2DGS by incorporating monocular depth and normal priors to improve both geometric accuracy and robustness. We propose a depth-guided initialization strategy for Gaussians and introduce a clustering-based technique for pruning degenerate Gaussians. We evaluate our method on the DTU dataset, where it achieves state-of-the-art results in mesh reconstruction while preserving high-quality novel view synthesis.

AI.tldr: 通过引入单目深度和法线先验，改进2D高斯泼溅（2DGS）的初始化与剪枝策略，在DTU数据集上实现了最优的网格重建与视图合成效果。
AI.motivation: 2DGS虽能实现视图一致且几何准确的表面重建，但对高斯基元的初始化敏感，依赖SfM的初始估计在复杂图像集上表现不佳，导致重建质量下降。
AI.method: 提出一种深度引导的高斯初始化策略，并引入基于聚类的退化高斯剪枝方法，结合单目深度与法线先验提升几何精度与鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在DTU数据集上，方法在网格重建任务中达到SOTA性能，同时保持高质量的视角合成效果。
AI.conclusion: 融合深度与法线先验显著提升了2DGS的初始化质量与几何准确性，为多视角表面重建提供了更鲁棒的解决方案。
